svg.title: CODE QUEST V2 — Pedro Costinha
svg.desc: Original 42 pixel explorer runs along the rim of PedroCostinha’s real GitHub calendar. Each week lights up as the explorer passes. 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-26, 319 contributions. Every square retains its real date, count and activity level. Coins mark real high-activity days, not commits. This is the static, reduced-motion version. Reduced motion shows the complete calendar and finish screen.
